content.Scope of the Guideline: The document refers to various guidelines and updates focusing on the treatment and management of cardiovascular conditions, including heart failure, coronary artery disease, valvular heart disease, hypertension, and myocardial infarction among others. These guidelines are authored by collaborations among various associations such as the American College of Cardiology, American Heart Association, and other related bodies.
